definitions.explanation: A fine white starch powder used for thickening sauces, coating foods for frying, and other culinary purposes.

examples.japanese: {片栗粉|かたくりこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦とろみ→とろみ：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.notes: とろみをつける is the standard expression for thickening

examples.japanese: ⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{片栗粉|かたくりこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まぶして→まぶす：18477_mabusu⟧⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Coat the chicken with potato starch and deep-fry it.
examples.notes: まぶす means to coat/dust with powder

examples.japanese: ⟦{水溶|みずと}き→水溶き：noentry⟧{片栗粉|かたくりこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please add the potato starch mixed with water.
examples.notes: 水溶き片栗粉 is starch dissolved in water, used for thickening

examples.japanese: ⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{片栗粉|かたくりこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦とろみ→とろみ：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I added potato starch to thicken the soup.

examples.japanese: {片栗粉|かたくりこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦サクサク→さくさく：05887_sakusaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{揚|あ}がる→揚がる：28726_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Using potato starch produces a crispier fry than wheat flour.

notes:
Originally made from the katakuri plant (dogtooth violet), but modern {片栗粉|かたくりこ} is typically potato starch (⟦{馬鈴薯|ばれいしょ}→馬鈴薯：28704_bareisho⟧⟦でんぷん→デンプン：11028_denpun⟧).

Common uses:
- Thickening agent for ⟦{餡|あん}かけ→餡かけ：28727_ankake⟧ (thick sauce dishes)
- Coating for ⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧ (creates crispier texture than flour)
- Making ⟦わらび→わらび：noentry⟧⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧ (warabi mochi)

Difference from ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧: {片栗粉|かたくりこ} creates a crispier, lighter coating and clearer thickening compared to wheat flour.
